name: fireplace
description: Light wood framed fireplace with square grey tile facing, positioned on the left side of the image under a white wall.

name: mantel
description: Light wood mantel running horizontally above the fireplace, holds decor objects.

name: recessed wall alcove
description: Deep rectangular wall alcove centered above and to the right of the fireplace, extends from ceiling to mantel height, painted the same color as surrounding walls.

name: ceiling bulkhead
description: Horizontal ceiling drop/bulkhead along the top middle of the image, creating a step down above the TV and lamp.

name: flooring
description: Medium-dark brown, wood-style plank flooring covering the entire visible floor area.

name: wall switch
description: White light switch located on the wall below the alcove, to the left of the floor lamp.

name: wall
description: White painted walls forming the background of the image, spanning from left edge to right edge.

name: decor on mantel
description: Set of five decor items on the mantel: a wooden plaque with engraved tree and writing, white round wall clock, small rectangular decor, glass dish, and a square wedding photo frame in the left alcove.

name: floor lamp
description: Tall wooden tripod floor lamp with woven shade, positioned at center right, in front of the alcove, casting a warm light on the wall.

name: TV stand
description: Light wood TV stand with rattan panel doors and open middle shelf, beneath the TV against the right wall.

name: TV
description: Large flat-screen TV sitting on top of the TV stand, slightly right of the center of the image.

name: candles and decor on TV stand
description: Multiple small candles and framed photos arranged on the top and inner shelf of the TV stand.

name: laundry hamper
description: Tall white fabric laundry hamper with handles, sitting on the floor to the right of the TV stand.
